id.description: Capability id in kebab-case — it names the catalog directory (e.g., 'shared-cache')

summary.description: One-line summary (1-160 chars) shown by `ndigo capabilities`

packages.description: Composing @ndigo/* packages (e.g., @ndigo/cache) — their manifests must declare the capability

guide.description: Guide slug the capability links to (e.g., '21-persistence-and-shared-stores')
